title: Local data processing helps teams catch machine issues earlier
summary: Learn how local data processing helps maintenance and operations identify equipment issues before they affect production—and how the ProSoft ELX3 supports it.
body_markdown:
## Processing data at the edge depends on device communication


Before a team can aggregate or analyze operational inputs locally, devices must be able to share information back and forth. But this can be a challenge when devices use different industrial protocols and don’t naturally exchange data.


For organizations using EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP/IP equipment, protocol conversion can establish a communication path, but that’s only the starting point. Once relevant data is available, a local application must be able to organize or interpret it for a specific purpose: condition monitoring, data aggregation, predictive maintenance or custom analytics, for example.


### How the ProSoft ELX3 supports local applications


The[ProSoft ELX3 ProLinx Edge Gateway](https://www.belden.com/news/belden-expands-edge-computing-portfolio-with-prolinx-edge-gateway) combines the communication and application capabilities needed to support localized data processing. It gathers and processes data at the network edge for localized decision-making, helping teams **identify, interpret and respond to emerging conditions** .


By combining EtherNet/IP-to-Modbus TCP/IP protocol conversion with the ability to run user-defined applications on the same gateway, the ELX3 lets organizations connect applicable devices and run a local application that uses the resulting data.


Its ELX-EIP-MBTCP container supports communication between applicable EtherNet/IP and Modbus TCP/IP devices. By running custom containers, it allows users to deploy their own code and algorithms for applications like data aggregation, machine learning and predictive maintenance.


## Address issues before they impact production


When relevant data can be brought together and evaluated near the equipment or process, teams have a better chance of **understanding what that data means** so they can decide whether an issue needs attention before it affects production.


For organizations that need to collect, interpret and use device data for local data processing, the ProSoft ELX3 ProLinx Edge Gateway provides a way to connect applicable device data and put it to work on a specific operational need.


**Small changes don’t have to become major disruptions** as long as teams have the context to recognize and address them early.
